reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from her own June 9 post in #central-team. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 the day before, and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis then said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store's login.

I couldn't find any Marrow Agrisupply account files I have access to, so I couldn't check this against the account records.
